blocks.text: Every driver knows the effortless satisfaction of an engine operating at its best—smooth, responsive, and maximizing every drop of fuel in the tank. But as distance accumulates, subtle yet inevitable changes in how a vehicle feels behind the wheel can start to show up like slight lags during acceleration or losing momentum on steep inclines. While many attribute these shifts to normal wear and tear, more often than not, an invisible culprit is at work. Carbon deposits may build up on critical engine components such as fuel injectors that can restrict optimal fuel flow, affect combustion, and alter engine performance. This […]...
